feeds.title: The Gothic Library
feeds.description: A gothic book blog for dark-minded readers of all types. Julia, your Gothic Librarian, is a bibliophile and lover of literature. The only thing in her life that rivals her passion for books is her proclivity for the dark and macabre.

feeds.title: Romancing the Gothic
feeds.description: My name is Dr. Hirst and I completed my Ph.D. in the Theology of the Early British Gothic. I'm a Gothic and a Romance nerd, and I'm bringing those loves together by putting on free classes and organizing book groups so that we can all enjoy this stuff as a family.

feeds.title: The Gothic Wanderer
feeds.description: The Gothic Wanderer is a blog about all things Gothic -- classic novels, movies, and how the Gothic continues to permeate our lives.

feeds.title: Books on the 7:47 » Gothic
feeds.description: Hello! I'm Jen, and I've been writing book reviews since 2009, just in the old-school way of pen on paper in a notebook. I started doing that too - partly - never forget the different books I'd read through the years, and - partly - to have as a reference for when I wanted a book to suit a certain mood.

feeds.title: Generally Gothic
feeds.description: Articles exploring the gothic within the literature, art, architecture, film, television, social history, and more.

feeds.title: The Gothic Bookworm Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Lauren, aka, The Gothic Bookworm. Welcome to my blog, well, bookshelf! Here you will find stories that are all about the Gothic! Be careful, once you open your eyes to the world of Gothic, you might not be able to leave... If you have a book you want me to review, head over to my 'Review Requests' page. If you fancy submitting an article/blog post to The Gothic Bookworm, head over to my 'Submissions' page

feeds.title: Shoshi's Book Blog » Gothic Literature
feeds.description: Book reviews, reading projects and general reflections: a blog devoted to my love of all things literary. I'll be trying to be varied in terms of topics, genres and periods, with a determined focus on staying up to date with recent publications.
